paired_method.population: Identical directed route, UTC origin and tenor labels in both cadences.
paired_method.difference: Left absolute error minus right absolute error, in log basis points.
paired_method.interval_scope: Descriptive individual UTC-day intervals within a split, without pooling seeds or asset cohorts.
paired_method.cadence_scope: Fitted model and history decimation at matched origins. Separate every-five-second origin sensitivity uses the same aligned subset.
paired_method.locked_outcome_read_gate: Both verified completion and selection receipts checked before opening held-out NPZ labels.
